title: Convergence from even and odd subsequences
statement: Let $f:\bbn\to\bbr$ and $L\in\bbr$. If both subsequences $f(2m)$ and $f(2m+1)$ tend to $L$ as $m\to\infty$, then $f(n)$ tends to $L$ as $n\to\infty$.
